intro: Good evening, gentlemen. Gameweek 7 is done. Results included Everton 0-2 Chelsea, Brentford 1-2 Liverpool and Fulham 1-0 Hull City. Ben top-scored with 70; Asher managed 31. Ben leads on 378, 42 clear of Asher. Nobody panic.
motw: Ben scored 70, the best of the week. Kostoulas (12), Vuskovic (11) and Tavernier (10) did the heavy lifting. Now 1st on 378.
stinker: 31 points. That's the lot. De Cuyper top-scored with 6, which tells you how the rest went.
bench: 23 points left on the bench. Horníček (2), Neto (15), Hall (4) and Kerkez (2) watched from the side. Team selection remains an art, not a science.
bench_jam: Sávio didn't play, so Bassey came off Louie's bench and scored 8. A clean sheet and 10 defensive actions. Luck is a skill if you say it confidently.
gloves: Donnarumma (Man City) scored 1 for Asher. Conceded 2. Made 1 saves, for what it's worth.
